title: Guidance for GenomeTrakr Metadata Templates Validation
author: Maria Balkey

steps.title: Download BioSample metadata template
steps.instruction: Visit the GenomeTrakr Metadata Validation System (GMVS) at https://gmvs.fda.gov/, click the ONE HEALTH ENTERIC icon inside the NCBI Metadata Validation box, and follow the GMVS prompts to download the appropriate BioSample metadata template (full package or a sub‑package) by selecting the cloud‑download icon.

steps.title: Complete BioSample metadata entries
steps.instruction: Open the downloaded OHE Excel file, review the “Instructions” sheet, then fill out the BioSample metadata in the “UserEntry” sheet, using dropdown menus wherever possible for each attribute.

steps.title: Validate and finalize BioSample template
steps.instruction: Upload the completed OHE BioSample template to GMVS, click the VALIDATE icon, allow GMVS (which runs LexMapr) to check entries, review the LexMapr report (columns: strain, isolation_source, isolation_source (LexMapr generated), IFSAC_category), copy the recommended isolation_source and IFSAC_category values into the validated template, leave any incorrect IFSAC_category blank and email genometrakr@fda.hhs.gov with a bug report, then click OK and save the validated BioSample template.

steps.title: Download SRA metadata spreadsheet
steps.instruction: Go to the NCBI Submission Templates page at https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/templates/ and download the generic “Metadata spreadsheet with sample names” file.

steps.title: Populate SRA spreadsheet with filenames
steps.instruction: In the downloaded spreadsheet, enter the fastq file names for each sample: on a Mac copy the file names directly from the folder into the sheet; on a PC use a command‑line method to obtain the names. If you have sequences belonging to more than one BioProject, create a separate submission and metadata table for each BioProject. Perform a QA/QC check by using Excel’s LEFT function to strip any appended text from file names and verify an exact match to the sample name.

steps.title: Save SRA sheet as TSV
steps.instruction: Save the second sheet (named SRA_data) as a tab‑delimited TSV file for upload in the “SRA metadata” tab of the NCBI submission portal (the original Excel file is also accepted).

steps.title: Submit BioSample and SRA to NCBI
steps.instruction: Proceed with the NCBI submission process using the validated BioSample metadata template and the TSV (or Excel) SRA_data file.

description: Address validation errors: If there are validation errors, GMVS will generate a log report. If few errors are reported, edit values by clicking the EDIT icon, otherwise, export reviewed template by clicking -EXPORT ERRORS-. Make required changes and click -RE-IMPORT SHEET- and proceed to re-validate the template. No validation errors: If metadata passes GMVS validation, each record will be displayed with all the metadata and you will have an option to export metadata. Click on the -EXPORT METADATA- icon. Review validated BioSample metadata and lexmapr output (cleaned up isolation_source entries and proposed IFSAC_category). go to step #3
